claims.title: One million jobs
claims.promise: Create one million jobs.
claims.method: Sector targets, investment support and a productive-loan fund.
claims.definition: Jobs announced in the 2026 programme; do not equate with HCP net employment.

history.title: The earlier million-job pledge
history.detail: Create one million direct jobs.

history.title: Investment charter adopted
history.detail: The House adopted framework law 03.22. This is a coalition-era instrument; adoption does not establish how many jobs it created.

history.title: Net employment changed unevenly
history.detail: HCP reports −24,000, −157,000, +82,000 and +193,000 jobs in successive years. These are economy-wide net changes, not a count of jobs caused by a party.

claims.limits: Delivery cannot yet be assessed for the next parliamentary term.

history.title: A later research-budget pledge
history.detail: The 2026 programme proposes a scientific-research budget of 2% of GDP. Budget scope and deadlines differ; this is not a measured fall in expenditure.

claims.limits: The 2030 deadline is still ahead. USFP was outside the executive in this term; no matching actual-expenditure series has been reviewed.
